Compute Network Circuity (Detour Ratio) for Sampled Junctions

Source: R/compute.R
walk_compute_circuity.Rd

Evaluates path directness by comparing network shortest-path distances against Euclidean straight-line distances. High circuity signifies indirect, circuitous street patterns and cul-de-sacs.

Usage

walk_compute_circuity(
  network,
  sample_size = 500,
  time_min = 10,
  cutoff_s = NULL
)

Arguments

network

A walk_network object.

sample_size

Number of random junctions to sample. Default is 500.

time_min

Walking time budget in minutes (default is 10.0 minutes).

cutoff_s

Optional walking time budget in seconds (default is NULL). If provided, it overrides time_min.

Value

A tibble with node IDs and calculated detour ratios.
